items.title: summary.ts: add additive primaryReportedTotal + primaryReportedCount to UsageSummary
items.context: In packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger/summary.ts add a primaryTotal (input+output, number|null) to DerivedRecordTotal computed in deriveRecordTotal: null when source=unavailable or when input OR output is null (never inferred); else input+output, independent of cache dims. In summarizeRecords accumulate primaryReportedTotal/primaryReportedCount over provider-reported records whose primaryTotal is non-null. Leave providerReportedTotal (strict four-field), estimateSubtotal, unknownCount EXACTLY as-is. Update both empty-summary returns in summarizeLedgerFile/summarizeRecords to include the new fields = 0.

happy.desc: Build a codex provider-reported record (input=500, output=200, cacheCreation=null, cacheRead=null) and call deriveRecordTotal -> primaryTotal should be 700 (input+output) and unknown should be true (four-field total null because cacheCreation null). WHY: confirms the new primaryTotal field computes input+output independently of cache dims

Build a claude provider-reported record with all four dims known (input=500, output=200, cacheCreation=10, cacheRead=50) and call deriveRecordTotal -> primaryTotal should be 700 and unknown should be false (four-field total is 760). WHY: confirms claude records contribute to primaryTotal AND the strict four-field total simultaneously

Summarize a mix of records: 1 codex (input=500,output=200,cache*=null), 1 gemini (input=800,output=120,cacheCreation=null,cacheRead=40), 1 claude (input=500,output=200,cacheCreation=10,cacheRead=50) -> primaryReportedTotal = 500+200 + 800+120 + 500+200 = 2320, primaryReportedCount = 3; providerReportedTotal = 760 (claude only, the only four-field-known record), providerReportedCount = 1, unknownCount = 2. WHY: verifies the additive primary aggregate includes cache-less providers while strict four-field semantics remain unchanged
Call summarizeLedgerFile with a non-existent path -> returned summary has primaryReportedTotal=0 and primaryReportedCount=0. WHY: confirms empty-summary returns include the new fields at zero
Call summarizeRecords([]) with empty array -> returned summary has primaryReportedTotal=0 and primaryReportedCount=0. WHY: confirms the other empty-summary return path also initializes new fields

edge.desc: Record with source=prompt-size-estimate (input=100,output=50,cache*=null) -> primaryTotal is 150 but record does NOT contribute to primaryReportedTotal (estimates excluded from primary aggregate). WHY: estimates must never pollute the primary aggregate just as they are excluded from providerReportedTotal
Record with source=unavailable -> primaryTotal is null regardless of dimension values. WHY: unavailable source must produce null primaryTotal by design (same as four-field behavior)
Record with input=null, output=200 (provider-reported) -> primaryTotal is null because input is null (never infer missing input). WHY: the spec says primaryTotal = null when input OR output is null

Record with input=0, output=0 (provider-reported, all four dims 0) -> primaryTotal = 0 (not null); providerReportedTotal includes it. WHY: genuine zero is distinct from null/unknown — zero is a valid reported count

adversarial.desc: Confirm that the UsageLedgerSummary type includes primaryReportedTotal and primaryReportedCount at the type level (TypeScript compilation check) and that providerReportedTotal, estimateSubtotal, unknownCount fields are byte-identical to the pre-story type (no field removed or renamed). WHY: the story is ADDITIVE — existing fields must not be modified or removed

A record with input=500, output=200, cacheCreation=null contributes to primaryReportedTotal=700 but NOT to providerReportedTotal (still unknown). Verify primaryReportedTotal and providerReportedTotal are independently computed — no cross-contamination where a record counted in primary is also silently added to the strict total. WHY: ensures the two aggregates are truly independent accumulators

verificationEvidence.note: CHK-PRIMARY builds the exact codex record (input=500,output=200,cacheCreation/cacheRead=null): 'CHK-PRIMARY summary' asserts its 700 input+output flows into primaryReportedTotal while it stays four-field unknown (unknownCount=2 incl. codex), and 'CHK-PRIMARY aggregateByGroup' asserts the codex group primaryKnown={500,200} with knownCount=0/unknownCount=1 — primaryTotal=input+output computed independently of cache dims.

CHK-PRIMARY builds the claude all-four record (input=500,output=200,cacheCreation=10,cacheRead=50): asserts it contributes 700 to primaryReportedTotal AND 760 to providerReportedTotal (four-field known) simultaneously.

'CHK-PRIMARY summary: codex+gemini+claude all contribute' asserts primaryReportedTotal=2320 / primaryReportedCount=3; 'strict four-field UNCHANGED' asserts providerReportedTotal=760 / count=1 / unknownCount=2.
'CHK-PRIMARY empty/absent' asserts summarizeLedgerFile(resolveLedgerPath(<absent>)) returns primaryReportedTotal=0 and primaryReportedCount=0.
'CHK-PRIMARY empty/absent' asserts summarizeRecords([]) returns primaryReportedTotal=0 and primaryReportedCount=0.

'CHK-PRIMARY edge' uses a both-dims-known estimate (input=100,output=50) and asserts primaryReportedTotal=0 (estimates excluded from the provider-reported primary aggregate) while its own prompt-size-estimate bucket carries primaryKnown={100,50}.
'CHK-PRIMARY deriveRecordTotal: source=unavailable' asserts deriveRecordTotal(<unavailable record>).primaryTotal===null regardless of dimension values.

'CHK-PRIMARY deriveRecordTotal: null input' builds a synthetic provider-reported record (inputTokens=null,outputTokens=200) and asserts primaryTotal===null (never inferred) and summarizeRecords([it]).primaryReportedCount===0.

'CHK-PRIMARY deriveRecordTotal: all-four-zero' asserts deriveRecordTotal(input=0,output=0,cache=0/0).primaryTotal===0 (genuine zero, NOT null), unknown===false, and summarizeRecords gives providerReportedCount===1/providerReportedTotal===0/unknownCount===0 — zero vs null distinction explicit.

tsc build is clean with primaryReportedTotal + primaryReportedCount added to UsageLedgerSummary; existing fields providerReportedTotal/estimateSubtotal/unknownCount are unchanged — proven additive: usage-ledger-smoke (61) and usage-ledger-estimate-smoke (55) still pass with identical pre-story values.

'CHK-PRIMARY summary' + 'strict four-field UNCHANGED' prove the two accumulators are independent: the codex record (700) is added to primaryReportedTotal but NOT to providerReportedTotal (stays in unknownCount); claude is in both — no cross-contamination.

items.title: diagnostics.ts: add per-source primary aggregate to rollups, keep four-field + cost unchanged
items.context: In packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger/diagnostics.ts add a PrimaryTokenDimensions {input,output} plus an asPrimaryDimensions helper (null when input or output null). Extend SourceTokenTotals with primaryKnown {input,output} + primaryKnownCount, init in emptySourceTotals. In aggregateByGroup accumulate primaryKnown independent of the four-field known check (a cache-less record is four-field-unknown yet primary-known); still exclude source=unavailable. Roll primaryKnown/primaryKnownCount into overall in buildUsageReport (SourceTotalsWithCost inherits the fields). Keep `known`, knownCount, unknownCount, and computeCost (four-field only) unchanged. Preserve the zero-cross-module-import invariant. Optionally surface primary in usage-ledger-report.ts renderHuman.

happy.desc: Build a codex provider-reported record (input=500, output=200, cacheCreation=null, cacheRead=null), run aggregateByGroup -> bySource["provider-reported"].primaryKnown should be {input:500, output:200} and primaryKnownCount=1, while bySource["provider-reported"].known should have knownCount=0 and unknownCount=1 (four-field unknown because cacheCreation null). WHY: confirms a cache-less record is four-field-unknown yet primary-known

Build a claude provider-reported record (all four dims known: input=500, output=200, cacheCreation=10, cacheRead=50), run aggregateByGroup -> bySource["provider-reported"].primaryKnown={input:500,output:200}, primaryKnownCount=1, AND known={input:500,output:200,cacheCreation:10,cacheRead:50}, knownCount=1. WHY: claude records appear in BOTH primary and four-field aggregates

Build a mix of codex+gemini+claude records, call buildUsageReport -> overall.bySource["provider-reported"].primaryKnown.input = sum of all three inputs, primaryKnownCount=3; overall known/knownCount reflect only the claude record. WHY: verifies rollup into overall preserves the dual-aggregate semantics

Per-group aggregation: two records in different groups (different storyIds) each contribute independently to their group primaryKnown and both roll into overall. WHY: confirms per-group isolation and correct overall accumulation

edge.desc: Record with source=unavailable -> excluded from primaryKnown (primaryKnownCount unchanged), excluded from known (unknownCount incremented). WHY: unavailable is excluded from primary aggregate, not just four-field

Record with input=null, output=200 (provider-reported) -> NOT counted in primaryKnown (input null means primary dimensions incomplete). WHY: primary requires both input AND output to be non-null, same as the summary.ts rule

emptySourceTotals() returns an object with primaryKnown={input:0,output:0} and primaryKnownCount=0 alongside the existing known/knownCount/unknownCount fields. WHY: confirms the zero-init includes the new fields

computeCost receives the same known (four-field) dimensions as before (no primary dimensions leak into cost computation). WHY: cost is strict four-field only; primary aggregate must not affect cost derivation

adversarial.desc: Static import analysis: diagnostics.ts imports only from ./summary.js, ./record.js, and node builtins — no cross-module import from outside usage-ledger/. WHY: preserves the zero-cross-module-import invariant stated in the story context

SourceTokenTotals type includes primaryKnown and primaryKnownCount at the TypeScript type level, and the existing fields (known, knownCount, unknownCount) remain unchanged in the type definition. WHY: ADDITIVE contract — existing type shape must not be modified

A prompt-size-estimate record with all four dims known (input=100, output=50, cacheCreation=0, cacheRead=0) contributes to its source bucket (prompt-size-estimate) primaryKnown, NOT to the provider-reported bucket. WHY: verifies source-bucket isolation is maintained for primary aggregate just as for four-field

verificationEvidence.note: 'CHK-PRIMARY aggregateByGroup: codex group is four-field-unknown yet primary-known' asserts bySource['provider-reported'].primaryKnown={input:500,output:200}, primaryKnownCount=1, knownCount=0, unknownCount=1.

'CHK-PRIMARY diagnostics: bySource provider-reported carries primaryKnown AND four-field known' asserts the claude record lands in primaryKnown {input:500,output:200} AND four-field known {500,200,10,50} with knownCount=1.

'CHK-PRIMARY diagnostics' via buildUsageReport asserts overall.bySource['provider-reported'].primaryKnown input=1800/output=520, primaryKnownCount=3, while four-field known reflects the claude record only (knownCount=1).

The three finals (codex/gemini/claude) are distinct groups (distinct model/provider/agentType); 'CHK-PRIMARY diagnostics' asserts each contributes independently and rolls into overall.bySource primaryKnownCount=3 (input=1800/output=520) — per-group isolation + correct overall accumulation.
'CHK-PRIMARY edge: estimate + unavailable do NOT contribute' asserts the unavailable final is excluded from primaryKnown (provider-reported primaryKnownCount=0) and counted unknown (unknownCount=1).

'CHK-PRIMARY diagnostics: aggregateByGroup excludes a null-input provider record from primaryKnown' builds a synthetic provider-reported record (inputTokens=null,outputTokens=200) and asserts the group's provider-reported primaryKnownCount===0 (both primary dims required; never inferred), unknownCount=1.

'CHK-PRIMARY diagnostics: buildUsageReport([]) zero-inits provider-reported primaryKnown' asserts overall.bySource['provider-reported'].primaryKnown deepEquals {input:0,output:0} and primaryKnownCount===0 (exercises emptySourceTotals init alongside the existing known/knownCount/unknownCount).

computeCost is strict four-field-only and unchanged; the diagnostics-smoke cost suite (cost formula incl. cache multipliers, no-table, unknown dims, all-zero, model-not-in-table, MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) still passes identically — the primary aggregate never feeds cost.

'static: usage-ledger module imports ZERO other Lattice modules' passes: diagnostics.ts imports only ./summary.js, ./record.js and node: builtins (PrimaryTokenDimensions/asPrimaryDimensions are in-module) — zero-cross-module-import invariant preserved.

tsc build is clean with SourceTokenTotals.primaryKnown + primaryKnownCount added; existing known/knownCount/unknownCount remain in the type unchanged — diagnostics-smoke (34) field-level asserts on known/knownCount/unknownCount still pass (additive type change).

'CHK-PRIMARY edge' synthEstimate with all four dims known (input=100,output=50,cacheCreation=0,cacheRead=0) is asserted to populate the prompt-size-estimate bucket primaryKnown={100,50}/count=1 but NOT the provider-reported bucket (primaryKnownCount=0) — source-bucket isolation for the primary aggregate.

items.title: Smoke: codex+gemini contribute to primary aggregate; strict four-field still excludes; claude in BOTH
items.context: Add/extend a smoke (e.g. packages/main/src/tasks/usage-ledger-codex-gemini-smoke.ts or a new usage-ledger-primary-total-smoke.ts wired into package.json + run-all-smokes) asserting: a codex (openai adapter) and a gemini provider-reported final each contribute their input+output to summary.primaryReportedTotal AND diagnostics bySource['provider-reported'].primaryKnown, while summary.providerReportedTotal and bySource.known STILL exclude them (unknownCount unchanged); an anthropic/claude record (all four dims known) appears in BOTH the strict four-field total and the primary total. Run the full smoke suite green.

happy.desc: Smoke runs end-to-end: creates codex (openai adapter, input=500, output=200, cache*=null), gemini (input=800, output=120, cacheCreation=null, cacheRead=40), and claude (input=500, output=200, cacheCreation=10, cacheRead=50) records via dispatch helpers, then asserts summary.primaryReportedTotal = 2320 and summary.primaryReportedCount = 3. WHY: the primary aggregate must include all three provider-reported records since all have non-null input+output

Same records: asserts summary.providerReportedTotal = 760 (claude only) and summary.providerReportedCount = 1, summary.unknownCount = 2 (codex+gemini four-field unknown). WHY: strict four-field semantics unchanged — cache-less providers still excluded from providerReportedTotal

Same records via buildUsageReport: asserts overall.bySource["provider-reported"].primaryKnown.input = 1800, primaryKnown.output = 520, primaryKnownCount = 3; AND overall.bySource["provider-reported"].known = {input:500, output:200, cacheCreation:10, cacheRead:50}, knownCount = 1. WHY: diagnostics primary aggregate end-to-end
Smoke is wired into package.json scripts AND run-all-smokes.ts (or equivalent entry), and the full smoke suite exits 0. WHY: confirms the new smoke is discoverable and does not break existing smokes

edge.desc: Smoke verifies that an estimate record does NOT contribute to primaryReportedTotal (stays at 2320, not inflated by estimate input+output). WHY: confirms estimate exclusion in the end-to-end path, matching summary.ts unit behavior
Smoke verifies that an unavailable record does NOT contribute to primaryReportedTotal. WHY: confirms unavailable exclusion in end-to-end path

adversarial.desc: Smoke asserts that providerReportedTotal, estimateSubtotal, estimateCount, and unknownCount values are byte-identical to what they would be WITHOUT the primary-aggregate feature (i.e., the new feature is purely additive and does not perturb existing aggregate values). WHY: regression safety — the story must not change any existing aggregate

Smoke asserts that diagnostics.ts known/knownCount/unknownCount per source are unchanged from pre-feature values (codex+gemini unknownCount=1 each in provider-reported, claude knownCount=1). WHY: four-field diagnostics aggregate must not be perturbed by the addition of primaryKnown

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke runs end-to-end via dispatch helpers creating codex/gemini/claude provider-reported finals; 'CHK-PRIMARY summary' asserts summary.primaryReportedTotal=2320 and primaryReportedCount=3.
Same records: 'CHK-PRIMARY summary: strict four-field UNCHANGED' asserts providerReportedTotal=760 (claude only), providerReportedCount=1, unknownCount=2 (codex+gemini four-field unknown).

Same records via buildUsageReport: 'CHK-PRIMARY diagnostics' asserts overall.bySource['provider-reported'].primaryKnown.input=1800 / output=520 / primaryKnownCount=3 AND four-field known={500,200,10,50} / knownCount=1.

run-all-smokes scans *-smoke.js and discovers usage-ledger-codex-gemini-smoke (also registered as npm script test:usage-ledger-codex-gemini in package.json); the --select usage-ledger run completes 9/9 green (suite exits 0, no existing smoke broken).

'CHK-PRIMARY edge' asserts a standalone estimate record does NOT contribute to primaryReportedTotal (estimate-only summary primaryReportedTotal=0; the 2320 mix is not inflated by estimate input+output).
'CHK-PRIMARY edge' asserts an unavailable final does NOT contribute to primaryReportedTotal (primaryReportedTotal=0 / primaryReportedCount=0 for the unavailable case).

'CHK-PRIMARY summary: strict four-field UNCHANGED' asserts providerReportedTotal=760, estimateSubtotal=0, estimateCount=0, unknownCount=2 are exactly the pre-feature values; usage-ledger-smoke (61) + estimate-smoke (55) confirm no existing aggregate perturbed (purely additive).

'CHK-PRIMARY diagnostics' + 'aggregateByGroup' assert per-source four-field known/knownCount/unknownCount unchanged: claude knownCount=1, codex/gemini four-field unknownCount=1 each — primaryKnown addition does not perturb the four-field diagnostics aggregate.
